title: NBA Logo Quiz Part 2: Hard Mode
headline: NBA Logo Quiz Part 2: Name The Team From A Tiny Piece Of Its Logo
description: A hard NBA logo quiz: eight tiny pieces of NBA team logos, about 2% of each logo. Guess the team, tap to reveal the answer, keep score and share your result.
intro: Every piece below is a small square cut from a current NBA team logo, about one fiftieth of the whole mark. No full letters, no team names, no giveaways. Each piece still holds one real detail, a color pair, a curve or an edge that belongs to only one team.
Make your guess, then tap Show The Answer. Be honest and mark whether you got it, and your score adds up at the bottom.

items.piece: Where the bottom of the hawk's head curls back in, red against white.
items.fact: The Hawks made this hawk head their primary logo again in June 2015. The team first used the design from 1972 to 1995.

items.piece: The gold outline around the top tip of the wine-colored C.
items.fact: The Cavaliers' current logos debuted on June 2, 2022. The redesign dropped navy and swapped the old mustard yellow for a shinier gold.

items.piece: The top of the bear's ear: gray outline, navy and the lighter blue inside.
items.fact: The Grizzlies refreshed their bear head in August 2018 with a new steel-gray outline, the brand's biggest update since 2004.

items.piece: The gray triangle at the right end of the logo, with a blue outline and a bit of orange.
items.fact: The Knicks' triangle logo dates to 1992, and New York was added across the top in 1995.

items.piece: The cream and green of one of the antlers.
items.fact: The Bucks unveiled their current buck head in April 2015. Its antlers are drawn to look like a basketball.

items.piece: The outer black edge and one red stripe of the pinwheel.
items.fact: The Blazers updated their pinwheel in May 2017. The lines stand for the players of the two teams meeting on the court.

items.piece: Where the purple stem of the note meets the top of the basketball.
items.fact: For 2025-26 the Jazz moved to purple, black and sky blue and kept the J-note as their main logo, now in purple.

items.piece: A black seam of the basketball meeting the outer ring.
items.fact: The Nets made this B on a basketball their primary logo for the 2024-25 season.
